questions.question: Moses said a prophet's sign came true, but he urged Israel to follow other gods. What must Israel do?
When a prophet urges Israel to follow other gods, what did Moses say the LORD is doing to find out if they love Him?
Moses warned Israel about people who urge them to worship other gods. Who did he say might secretly do this?

answers.text: Their own family or closest friend
A traveler from a far land
A priest serving at the altar

questions.question: Moses said Israel might hear that wicked men led a city to worship other gods. What should Israel do first?

answers.text: Send a prophet to warn it
